blurb: 12 Corners Vineyards offers wine clubs with bi-monthly shipments of selected wines. They have tasting rooms in Benton Harbor and Grand Haven with group reservations available on weekdays. The Riverstone Room is a private event space with vineyard views and AV equipment.
extraNote: Members must commit to minimum of 3 shipments before cancelling · Wine must be picked up within 3 months or it will be shipped · 50% deposit required to secure group tasting reservation · No group reservations on Saturdays at tasting rooms · No outside alcohol allowed on property · No alcohol served to anyone appearing intoxicated per MI law · Tasting rooms at Benton Harbor and Grand Haven locations
